concerns.text: FR-001 requires the system to compute structural descriptors (atomic radius, packing fraction) for each material. T001’s description mentions ‘preprocesses it (clean, material‑ID‑stratified split, PCA, exclusion reporting)’ but does not explicitly state that these descriptors are calculated, leaving a potential weakening of the functional requirement.

SC-005 (data validity: percentage of rows with null target values before exclusion) is listed in the Success Criteria but no task in the list addresses its measurement or reporting, resulting in a dropped acceptance criterion.
